messages:
pagerduty-bot: URGENT: P0 — Elevated 5xx rate detected for service="gateway" path=/v1/generate in prod-us-west. 5xx = 12.3% over 5m window, spike started around 4801234500. On-call: @devon paged.

devon: I'm on it. Starting log collection and marking incident. Any recent deploys?

elaine: No infra deploys in the last 10m from what I can see. I can take traces and throw an APM snapshot at the gateway pods. Which pods to target?

devon: gateway-frontend-7c9f and gw-proxy-2b4a. Tailing envoy logs now.

opsbot: deploy-bot: No application or infra deploys in prod-us-west in the last 30m. Last route config rollout ~2h ago (route-rollout-id: r-2026-03-14-18).

sam: Seeing a pattern: envoy upstream responses returning 502/504, then client retries spike afterwards. Feels like retries are amplifying backend instability.

carla: @devon can you disable route-level retries for /v1/generate temporarily? If retries are re-sending requests into a strained backend, that could be the root.

devon: Doing a hotfix now: setting retry_on: "none" and max_retries: 0 for that route. Patching envoy route config on gw-proxy.

devon: Command:
```
kubectl -n prod exec -it gw-proxy-2b4a -- /bin/sh -c '\n  cat <<EOF >/tmp/hotfix.yaml\nroute:\n  match:\n    prefix: "/v1/generate"\n  retry_policy:\n    retry_on: \"none\"\n    num_retries: 0\nEOF\n  envoyctl apply-config /tmp/hotfix.yaml\n'
```

devon: Patch applied and envoy hot-reloaded on gw-proxy pods. Rolling to gateway-frontend now.

elaine: Observing rates — 5xx dropped from 12.3% -> 2.1% within ~30s of disabling retries. Latency looks stable.

sam: I pulled connection stats from lb-backend: circuit_breakers for the backend had per-host max_connections=10. With retries bouncing, we hit the pool limit and envoys start getting 5xxs. That config plus retries = amplification loop.

devon: For immediate safety I bumped max_connections to 100 in the canary cb config on one shard and will promote if stable. Not doing global change until we confirm.

opsbot: incident-bot: customer-impact estimate: approx 18% of /v1/generate requests in prod-us-west were failing (5xx) between 4801234500–4801234560. No other regions affected.

carla: Support action: I'll send an initial message to MC and customer-facing channels: short blurb: "We observed elevated errors for the generate endpoint in us-west; mitigation applied (disabled retries and increased connection limits); monitoring ongoing."

devon: Creating incident doc (inc-4801234567) and capturing failed response samples + logs for postmortem. Also saving the pre-hotfix envoy config.

sam: Suggest we add a pipeline guard: don't allow a global route retry change without a traffic-stress smoke test. I'll open a ticket. Also audit who pushed the route change ~2h ago.

elaine: I'll add a canary smoke for retry behavior (send sampled traffic with induced 502s to ensure no amplification).

devon: Handoff: I'm handing monitoring to @sam. I'll remain reachable but stepping out of active command. If errors creep above 5% again, re-page me.

sam: Ack, watching dashboards + logs. If steady under 1% for 15m, we'll mark mitigated.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Rollout status — hotfix (disable retries) propagated to 4/4 gateway pods. Canary cb bump applied to shard-2.

pagerduty-bot: Please confirm closure once monitoring window passes.

devon: Marking incident as mitigated at 4801234605. Final rough impact: ~750 failed requests during spike (~0.02% of total prod traffic) localized to us-west. Root cause (initial hypothesis): route-level retries combined with aggressive circuit breaker limits on the backend caused request amplification and connection pool exhaustion. Follow-ups: rollback guard, retry smoke tests, audit of route config rollout.

carla: Thanks team — I'll draft the customer note + postmortem template and assign owners for follow-ups. Good job on the quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
